The platform analyzes terrain elevation, slope, surface characteristics, environmental conditions, and geological features to discover potential Earth analog sites for testing future space exploration technologies

summary:
**Summary**

TERRATWIN is an AI-powered geospatial intelligence platform that connects planetary exploration with real-world decision-making. It uses NASA datasets and other trusted scientific, geographical, economic and environmental sources to transform complex information into actionable insights.

Its Mars Intelligence system analyzes Martian terrain, evaluates potential landing regions, compares rover capabilities and generates optimized exploration routes using real elevation data and scientific measurements.

Its Earth Intelligence system allows users to describe projects in natural language, such as establishing a potato farm, building a solar power plant or evaluating nuclear energy opportunities. The AI agent researches relevant countries and regions by analyzing climate, soil, resources, infrastructure, labor costs and regulations.

Through interactive maps, scientific analysis and intelligent recommendations, TERRATWIN helps users discover suitable locations and make better-informed decisions.
details: TERRATWIN is an AI-powered planetary and Earth intelligence platform that transforms NASA and other open datasets into actionable insights. It analyzes Mars terrain, recommends landing sites and rover exploration routes, while helping users identify optimal locations on Earth for agriculture, energy projects and other activities. Users can explore data through interactive maps and an intelligent AI agent.
